The title/subtitle and source note identify the civilian unemployment rate, seasonal adjustment, first prints and missing October 2025 observation. Critical labels and source text are legible and uncropped.

Derived bars have no separate marker, but naming both dates in the legible source note gives adequate disclosure for this series. No new number, annualization or inflation adjustment is introduced.
Title, units, period labels and both lines of source text fit inside the image. The note and period window establish the first-release vintage.
